related.description: A delicate dircolors theme for ls that injects color without overwhelming your workspace - macOS friendly 
This is a repository of themes for GNU ls (configured via GNU dircolors) that support Ethan Schoonover’s Solarized color scheme.
A simple and dark theme enough for Alfred, iTerm, Sublime, Terminal (Mac), ZSH, Sequel Pro and Slack
:rainbow: Clean & vibrant color schemes for Vim, Terminals...
